findings: Import script output order — Sort sectors by category_id before publishing so workbook row reordering doesn't change the generated taxonomy order.
JSON serialization safety — Add allow_nan=False to json.dumps so non-finite floats fail serialization before the file is replaced.
Concurrent import collision — Use tempfile.mkstemp to generate unique temporary files per invocation, preventing collisions when imports run concurrently.

ISIC mapping granularity — Change Environment & Circular Economy / ISIC Rev. 4 waste division 38 from skos:exactMatch to skos:broadMatch since the sector includes renewable energy and climate advocacy beyond just waste management.
Migration atomicity — Combine organization clearing and cohort recording in a data-modifying CTE so the recorded IDs are exactly those whose sector_id was cleared.
Test precision — Assert that resolveCrosswalkMatches returns an empty array for CQCM labels with wrong source, not just that no match has that source.
Whitespace-only source normalization — Normalize whitespace-only source values to None before lookup key generation so label-only matches can resolve.
